decisions: Restore the two required snapshot methods, then select the first-greater cumulative-end search; retain duplicate endpoints and their original owners.
Keep production array JNI unchanged; make native C test failures executable when NDEBUG removes assert.
Preserve the existing legal range-navigation path. On rejected out-of-range endpoints, use a stored raw-owner anchor and traverse through the original known wrapper chain.
Preserve null presence using a real stored extreme instead of probing an unsupported null comparator input.
Reuse the persistent ordered predicate atom for list composition. Only private M3 conjunctions are opened; opaque predicates retain order and exception identity.

Flatten known read-only iterator decorators into temporary predicate references, not source elements. Preserve generic membership representative scans and repeated callback demand with explicit continuations.
Guard documented read-only default mutation paths before callbacks; delegate existing reversed reads to preserve their observed traversal shape.
Explicit exported default constructors preserve the original callable constructors and permit the existing strict module build.
oracle_corrections: Four independently established false test assumptions are corrected without changing M3LongTreeSet production behavior or weakening coverage.
limits: Structural/logic/similarity catalogue matches are candidate discovery signals, not proofs of equivalence.
Generic membership may retain quadratic predicate demand because that is part of the observed repeated representative scans.
Opaque third-party owner callback identity after rejected range construction, deep sorted range recursion and deeply nested strict read-only list owners are outside this pass acceptance.
The facade explicitly declares two already-inherited endpoint methods; callable closure is retained while declaration/reflection ownership changes are disclosed.
Platform-wide native portability and whole-JDK family promotion require their separate gates.
